summary.text: On Rabiah, a plane refracted by the Thousandfold Refraction into a thousand and one planes, the wizard Taysir is copied five times, once for each color, and Nailah seduces the black Taysir and has him kill and absorb the green one.

The nomad Taysir and the dervish Taysir hunt for the last of their counterparts, reaching the castle of El-Hajjaj, where Nailah wants the united Taysir to make her queen of all Rabiahs; the nomad Taysir defeats her and merges with his last counterpart, becoming the most powerful wizard in the multiverse.
Taysir then becomes a planeswalker, blasts Nailah when her seduction fails, and leaves, and she bars him from returning to any plane of Rabiah.
